title: fr.display.refresh arguments
description: E-paper: refresh now in `mode` (auto: partial, or full when the glass is not known, or the `clean` mode when the ghost budget is spent; an explicit partial runs past the budget; fast and full redraw the whole screen even with nothing new). RESULT: the mode that will run and whether the frame differs from the glass; `refreshed` follows (none when nothing changed and the mode is auto or partial). One refresh may wait while another runs; it takes the strongest mode asked. UNSUPPORTED where trait epaper is false.
